notes: Card: ' name' x12, ' married' x3, ' birth' x3, ' spouse' x2, ' names' x2, ' marry'. Probes: 'Father's name' 0.61, 'birth certificate' 0.63, ' spouse' 0.41, 'married couple' 0.38, ' marry' 0.16; 'File name' list 0.02, 'utility bill' 0.09, 'name of the company' and 'His name was' 0.19, 'birth of the nation' 0.13. So ' name' alone is not silent, and the form or kinship context raises it.
